quote: Union General Alexander Hays ordered the house and barn to be burned. By 11:30am, with the buildings’ destruction, a lull fell over the Bliss farm
says: The Bliss farmstead was fought over again on the morning of 3 July; Union General Alexander Hays ordered the house and barn burned, and by 11:30 a.m., with the buildings' destruction, a lull fell over the farm.
feature: the Bliss farmstead (house and barn burned on 3 July)
note: The report says nothing of the ground, the hay or the straw: the burning of the buildings is documented; that the ground of the yard was scorched and burnt is the inference of the vegetation lane (the plan's rule: burn spread is plausible-procedural, started only at a documented fire, PDF B.10.3). The hour is 'by 11:30am' (the report) and 'the morning' (the plan's timeline row T3-055).
